obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical relation; finite correspondence evidence only
obernants.assumptions: Successful standard allocations, terminating single-threaded calls
obernants.domain: Declared bounded API inputs, states and finite fixtures
obernants.observation_scope: Exact values, index order, state transitions and named assertions
obernants.operator: For a pre-state and key, candidate return/state pairs are excluded if membership is wrong, hit root differs from requested key, miss root differs from last visited node, or inorder set/parent structure changes incorrectly. Empty access returning true or creating a root is excluded. A new-key capacity error that mutates shape is excluded.

obernants.operator: An observed root after access admits all predecessor BSTs whose search ends at that key plus appropriate queries; multiple shapes and access histories can converge on the same root and inorder set. On a miss the resulting root identifies last visited key, not the absent query or original shape. Duplicate insertion false implies prior membership but loses earlier shape.

obernants.operator: If child-parent and parent-grandparent orientations match, rotate parent then child (zig-zig); otherwise child twice (zig-zag). With no grandparent use a single zig. These are standard splay cases, not merely move-to-root single rotations.
